sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Uninvited Guests - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Prapor already filled you in. Heard plenty of gunfire coming from the shore, so I wouldn't count on his guys making it out. I'm waiting on you with that crate. It's an important delivery!"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Obtain and hand over the case with military equipment

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +5,000 EXP
"Thanks for the help. If it weren't for you, I'd still be trying to patch things up with the client..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Case with military equipment | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to obtain and hand over to the BTR Driver a case with military equipment found on Shoreline.

The case is located at one of the 3 locations.
